sources.fact: Slider keyboard behavior includes arrow increments and decrements, with Home/End boundaries. Focus must reach the control before these keys are useful.
sources.decision: Retain native range inputs and numericKey; focus on pointer down and completed click without cancelling dragging.

sources.fact: Report dated 2025-09-18 describes range clicks lacking focus in Safari 18.6, unlike Chrome and Firefox, and an explicit focus workaround.
sources.decision: Do not infer that Linux WebKit reproduces macOS focus policy. Add a browser focus-policy shim regression plus native macOS WebKit CI.

sources.fact: ELK Layered supports self loops, multi edges and ports, and reorders layered nodes to minimize crossings.
sources.decision: The latest owner feedback prohibits automatic ordering changes. Retain existing continuous doublet geometry and fixed positions instead of introducing a layered router.

sources.fact: Graphviz overlap controls removal of overlapping nodes, including Prism-based handling.
sources.decision: Moving nodes to remove overlaps violates fixed placement, and does not score own-shaft collisions. Do not use automatically.

sources.fact: Neato uses spring-model node placement for undirected graphs.
sources.decision: Keep existing d3-force as an explicitly selected placement; never substitute force layout to clear automatic spacing residuals.

sources.fact: Pinned neato/fdp input positions can still be affected by overlap removal and aspect-ratio processing; translation can also be disabled separately.
sources.decision: Freeze the renderer fitting transform as well as node arrangement; compare actual image coordinates in regressions.

sources.fact: Incremental layout considers input coordinates and fixed elements to preserve the mental map when extending an existing drawing.
sources.decision: Treat existing link middles and colors as hard invariants and adjust only local reference geometry.
